TRACE IDEAS TO THEIR SOURCES

The selected source map.

The supplied inventory contains 446 records. These 38 selected, non-retired records inform 30 healthcare workflows. Original record names, stages and explicit adaptations are preserved.

HHS source entryMapped opportunitiesHHS-reported stage

This is a curated selection, not an exhaustive classification of all 446 records. Clinical and public health candidates require specialist review. Our prototypes use fictional inputs; HHS outcomes have not been replicated here.
